name: walk
note: (anim-rework S2, real-world standard, keyed by hand; never traced; M6 Michael 2026-10-20) The standing holstered walk. Upright (no forward lean: "it shouldn't lean at all until full speed"), the head level; the legs near vertical from the front with the feet landing close to a line under the hips (legs add 3 deg: track half-width about 4.5 cm at 1.75 m; "bring knees and legs in line with the body"), knees forward over the toes, the knee pole a touch inward (kneeOut -0.03: knees in line with the hips and feet); the arms hanging along the sides ("Arms should stay parallel the body"), swinging opposite the legs from the shoulder (forward 14, back 12 deg at full walk; the graph scales the swing with the pace); the weight over the planted foot, the pelvis turning a little against the chest (2 deg). Angles in degrees in the body frame (x right, y up, z forward): pitch about x (+ the top forward), yaw about y (+ turns right), roll about z (+ the right side up). Pelvis offsets in cm from rest (the height adds to the legs' own reach drop). Arms: flex (+ forward, in the chest frame: the world angle is flex minus the chest pitch), abd (+ out), elbow (+ bent), inward (the forearm turned in toward the midline). Legs (the Blender preview and the track only: the game's feet come from the foot planner): flex (+ the knee forward), add (+ the foot in toward the midline), knee (+ bent), ankle (+ the toes up). Phase 0 is the left heel strike; keys 0-0.375 are mirrored onto 0.5-0.875. (anim-rework S2b, Michael on slice 2: "There is animation issues, almost worse than before") The arms keyed larger (shoulder about +15 / -18 deg, elbow 20-40 at 1.4 m/s after the pace scale), the trunk counter-rotates (pelvis yaw 2.5, chest -5: the chest turns against the hips; the review asked pelvis 5, which put the forward foot 7.3 cm off the line in the pelvis frame, e2e-anim walk track <= 7), the weight transfers onto the stance foot (pelvis 1.5 cm over it, 3 cm of bob: low at the heel strike, high at mid-stance; the swing side drops 3 deg; the review asked 2 cm and 4 deg: at 2.1 m/s the knees then read 3 cm outside the ankles and the planted feet 7.1 cm off the line, e2e-anim speed 3). The pelvis sits 3 cm lower than slice 2 all cycle (dy -7 / -7.2 / -4.2 / -5.2): the soft stance knee, and the longer steps no longer reach the legs' limit at the double support (the IK drop added 6-7 cm of bob on top of these keys). (S2b) Legs add 3 -> 2.8 deg: the bigger pelvis yaw turns the feet in at the heel strike and toe-off, so the track half-width keeps its slice 2 value.
